pt.summary: A iniciativa da FAO Um País, Um Produto Prioritário apoia o caju, principal produto de exportação da Guiné-Bissau, através do mapeamento de produtores, formação em boas práticas agrícolas e reforço do processamento local.

sw.title: FAO yaimarisha mnyororo wa thamani wa korosho nchini Guinea-Bissau kupitia mbinu endelevu na utofauti wa mapato
sw.summary: Mpango wa FAO wa Nchi Moja, Bidhaa Moja ya Kipaumbele unaunga mkono korosho, bidhaa kuu ya mauzo ya nje ya Guinea-Bissau, kupitia utambuzi wa wazalishaji, mafunzo ya mbinu bora za kilimo na kuimarisha uchakataji wa ndani.

articles.title: World Bank documents how Lesotho smallholder farmers expanded climate-smart vegetable businesses
articles.summary: The World Bank's feature story follows smallholder farmers who used matching grants, irrigation, protected cultivation and market links to expand vegetable production and create rural jobs in Lesotho.

articles.title: International Day of Potato 2026 highlights Lesotho's potato value chain and rural livelihoods
articles.summary: FAO's global potato observance in Maseru highlighted Lesotho's plans to expand potato production, improve access to quality seed and agronomic training, and strengthen market opportunities for farmers through its One Country One Priority Product initiative.
articles.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

fr.title: La Journée internationale de la pomme de terre 2026 met en valeur la filière et les moyens de subsistance ruraux du Lesotho
fr.summary: La célébration mondiale organisée à Maseru par la FAO a souligné les projets du Lesotho visant à accroître la production de pommes de terre, améliorer l’accès aux semences de qualité et à la formation agronomique, et élargir les débouchés commerciaux.

ar.title: اليوم الدولي للبطاطس 2026 يبرز سلسلة قيمة البطاطس وسبل العيش الريفية في ليسوتو
ar.summary: سلط الاحتفال العالمي الذي نظمته منظمة الأغذية والزراعة في ماسيرو الضوء على خطط ليسوتو لزيادة إنتاج البطاطس وتحسين الوصول إلى البذور الجيدة والتدريب الزراعي وتوسيع فرص التسويق للمزارعين.

pt.title: Dia Internacional da Batata 2026 destaca a cadeia de valor da batata e os meios de vida rurais no Lesoto
pt.summary: A celebração global organizada pela FAO em Maseru destacou os planos do Lesoto para aumentar a produção de batata, melhorar o acesso a sementes de qualidade e formação agronómica e ampliar as oportunidades de mercado para os agricultores.

sw.title: Siku ya Kimataifa ya Viazi 2026 yaangazia mnyororo wa thamani wa viazi na maisha ya vijijini Lesotho
sw.summary: Maadhimisho ya kimataifa yaliyoandaliwa na FAO mjini Maseru yalionyesha mipango ya Lesotho ya kuongeza uzalishaji wa viazi, kuboresha upatikanaji wa mbegu bora na mafunzo ya kilimo, na kupanua fursa za masoko kwa wakulima.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Liberia 2026 highlights rice, cocoa and maize investment
articles.summary: FAO's Liberia 2026 profile presents USD 370 million of investment opportunities in rice, cassava, cocoa and maize, with a strong focus on import substitution and value-chain development.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Liberia is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: Atoms4Food assessment charts a path toward food security in Liberia
articles.summary: FAO and IAEA's Atoms4Food country assessment is examining how science and nuclear techniques can support food security, agricultural productivity, food safety and nutrition in Liberia.

articles.title: Libyan partners advance Marwat 2 project coordination for sustainable agricultural water management
articles.summary: A January 2026 technical meeting involving FAO and Libyan institutions discussed the Marwat 2 project, scientific evaluation of agricultural projects, more efficient irrigation-water use and data-informed planning.
articles.source: Libyan Organization for Agriculture and Environment (LOAE)

articles.title: FAO warns of below-average cereal output and rising food-import needs in Libya
articles.summary: FAO's July 2026 country brief says dry conditions reduced cereal planting in parts of Libya, with 2026 cereal production forecast about 20 percent below the five-year average and cereal import needs for 2026/27 above average.
articles.source: FAO Global Information and Early Warning System (GIEWS)

fr.title: La FAO prévoit une production céréalière inférieure à la moyenne et des besoins d’importation accrus en Libye
fr.summary: Le bulletin de juillet 2026 indique que la sécheresse a réduit les superficies céréalières dans certaines régions de Libye et que la production pourrait être inférieure d’environ 20 % à la moyenne quinquennale.

ar.title: منظمة الأغذية والزراعة تحذر من انخفاض إنتاج الحبوب عن المتوسط وارتفاع احتياجات الاستيراد في ليبيا
ar.summary: ذكر تقرير يوليو 2026 أن الجفاف قلّص المساحات المزروعة بالحبوب في أجزاء من ليبيا، وأن إنتاج 2026 قد يقل بنحو 20 بالمئة عن متوسط السنوات الخمس.

pt.title: FAO prevê produção de cereais abaixo da média e aumento das necessidades de importação na Líbia
pt.summary: O boletim de julho de 2026 indica que a seca reduziu as áreas semeadas com cereais em partes da Líbia e que a produção poderá ficar cerca de 20% abaixo da média dos últimos cinco anos.

sw.title: FAO yaonya kuhusu uzalishaji wa nafaka chini ya wastani na mahitaji makubwa ya uagizaji Libya
sw.summary: Taarifa ya Julai 2026 inasema ukame ulipunguza maeneo yaliyopandwa nafaka katika sehemu za Libya na uzalishaji wa 2026 unaweza kuwa chini kwa takriban asilimia 20 ya wastani wa miaka mitano.

articles.title: Madagascar highlights rice, maize, soybean and special economic zones in 2026 agrifood investment agenda
articles.summary: Madagascar's 2026 Hand-in-Hand agenda includes rice, maize and soybean value chains and six special economic zones targeting market gardening, rice, maize, soybean and fodder.

articles.title: AfDB project page: Lower Mangoky Irrigation Area Extension Project Phase II
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's project page lists the Lower Mangoky Irrigation Area Extension Project Phase II in Madagascar and its March 2026 appraisal report.

articles.title: AfDB approves emergency support for communities affected by Cyclone Gezani in Madagascar
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's project page records a US$500,000 emergency grant to support communities affected by Cyclone Gezani, including food-security assistance and resilience to recurring climate shocks.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Malawi fisheries, aquaculture and watershed project update
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's September 2026 agriculture update reports implementation progress on Malawi's sustainable fisheries, aquaculture development and watershed management project.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Malawi is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Malawi is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: World Bank Group soil-health programme expands agricultural-support reform
articles.summary: Malawi is one of six African countries participating in a programme focused on better fertilizer-support design and soil health.

articles.title: IFAD TRADE programme continues agricultural diversification and entrepreneurship support in Malawi
articles.summary: IFAD's project portfolio lists a July 2026 supervision report for the Transforming Agriculture through Diversification and Entrepreneurship Programme, covering agricultural diversification, entrepreneurship and rural value chains in Malawi.

articles.title: AfDB and Mali business leaders strengthen access to private-sector financing
articles.summary: Stakeholders discussed financing instruments, bankable projects, blended finance, guarantees and technical assistance, including opportunities in agro-industry and the cotton value chain.

articles.title: Climate-smart agriculture initiative targets Mali smallholders through research and innovation
articles.summary: Mali is included in the AICCRA–FSRP4 regional initiative, which aims to scale climate-smart solutions and climate information services and strengthen connections between research and farmers.

articles.title: IITA study highlights climate-smart agriculture potential for Mali smallholders
articles.summary: A September 2026 IITA and IER study found that climate-smart agriculture practices could strengthen food security and improve diet quality among smallholder farming households facing climate and insecurity pressures.

articles.title: AfDB updates Mauritania Agricultural Transformation Support Project implementation record
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's project page lists the November 2025 implementation progress report for Mauritania's PATAM agricultural transformation project, including activity updates and procurement notices.

articles.title: Mauritania and FAO advance digital transformation of agrifood systems
articles.summary: FAO specialists worked with Mauritanian authorities and development partners to strengthen the country's digital agriculture agenda, building on an e-agriculture strategy and wider digital public-service infrastructure.
articles.source: FAO Regional Office for the Near East and North Africa

fr.title: La Mauritanie et la FAO font progresser la transformation numérique des systèmes agroalimentaires
fr.summary: Des spécialistes de la FAO ont travaillé avec les autorités mauritaniennes et les partenaires au développement pour renforcer l’agriculture numérique, en s’appuyant sur une stratégie nationale d’agriculture électronique et sur les services publics numériques.

ar.title: موريتانيا ومنظمة الأغذية والزراعة تعززان التحول الرقمي للنظم الزراعية والغذائية
ar.summary: عمل خبراء المنظمة مع السلطات الموريتانية وشركاء التنمية على تعزيز الزراعة الرقمية بالاستناد إلى استراتيجية وطنية للزراعة الإلكترونية وتطور البنية التحتية للخدمات العامة الرقمية.

pt.title: Mauritânia e FAO avançam na transformação digital dos sistemas agroalimentares
pt.summary: Especialistas da FAO trabalharam com as autoridades mauritanas e parceiros de desenvolvimento para reforçar a agricultura digital, com base numa estratégia nacional de agricultura eletrónica e na expansão dos serviços públicos digitais.

sw.title: Mauritania na FAO zaendeleza mabadiliko ya kidijitali ya mifumo ya kilimo na chakula
sw.summary: Wataalamu wa FAO walishirikiana na mamlaka za Mauritania na washirika wa maendeleo kuimarisha kilimo cha kidijitali, kwa kutegemea mkakati wa kitaifa wa kilimo cha kielektroniki na miundombinu ya huduma za umma za kidijitali.

articles.title: Mauritius presents grants, vouchers and equipment schemes to support planters and breeders
articles.summary: The Ministry of Agro-Industry reported support schemes for planters and breeders, including vouchers, grants, cheques and agricultural equipment under the 2025–2026 accompanying measures.
articles.source: Ministry of Agro-Industry, Food Security, Blue Economy and Fisheries — Mauritius

articles.title: Mauritius launches Precision Farming and AI-Driven Food Production Scheme
articles.summary: The Food and Agricultural Research and Extension Institute (FAREI) launched the scheme on 18 August 2026. Eligible local producers can receive a grant covering 50% of eligible project costs, capped at MUR 2 million, for precision agriculture, automation, smart water management and advanced growing systems.
articles.source: Food and Agricultural Research and Extension Institute (FAREI), Mauritius

fr.title: Maurice lance un programme d’agriculture de précision et de production alimentaire fondée sur l’IA
fr.summary: L’Institut mauricien de recherche et de vulgarisation agricoles a lancé un programme aidant les agriculteurs à adopter drones, stations météo, capteurs de sol et de plantes, irrigation intelligente et conseils numériques pour améliorer la productivité et la résilience.

ar.title: موريشيوس تطلق برنامجاً للزراعة الدقيقة وإنتاج الغذاء المدعوم بالذكاء الاصطناعي
ar.summary: أطلق معهد البحوث والإرشاد الزراعي في موريشيوس برنامجاً لمساعدة المزارعين على استخدام الطائرات المسيّرة ومحطات الطقس ومستشعرات التربة والنبات والري الذكي والإرشاد الرقمي لزيادة الإنتاجية والقدرة على الصمود.

pt.title: Maurícia lança programa de agricultura de precisão e produção alimentar orientada por IA
pt.summary: O Instituto de Investigação e Extensão Agrícola das Maurícias lançou um programa para ajudar agricultores a adotar drones, estações meteorológicas, sensores de solo e plantas, irrigação inteligente e aconselhamento digital para melhorar a produtividade e a resiliência.

sw.title: Mauritius yazindua mpango wa kilimo cha usahihi na uzalishaji wa chakula unaotumia AI
sw.summary: Taasisi ya Utafiti na Ugani wa Kilimo ya Mauritius imezindua mpango wa kuwasaidia wakulima kutumia ndege zisizo na rubani, vituo vya hali ya hewa, vihisi vya udongo na mimea, umwagiliaji mahiri na ushauri wa kidijitali kuongeza uzalishaji na ustahimilivu.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Morocco PADIDZAR technical-assistance implementation update
articles.summary: The African Development Bank published a May 2026 implementation progress and results report for technical assistance under Morocco's PADIDZAR agricultural and rural development programme.

articles.title: IFAD project page: Integrated Rural Development Project in Morocco's Khenifra province
articles.summary: IFAD's official project page describes the Integrated Rural Development Project in Khenifra province, including the project design report and financing information.

articles.title: AfDB project page: Morocco PAASIFEJ support programme for women and young farmers
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's project page covers Morocco's PAASIFEJ programme, which aims to improve food security, create sustainable jobs and strengthen the resilience of smallholder agriculture, with a focus on women and young people.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Morocco climate-fund project completion report for agricultural environmental and social studies
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's completion report covers environmental and social studies prepared for a climate-fund financing proposal, including safeguards for projects in Morocco's agricultural and rural development portfolio.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Mozambique 2026 highlights seed, irrigation and mechanization opportunities
articles.summary: FAO's Mozambique 2026 profile presents USD 135.05 million of investment opportunities in certified seed multiplication, private irrigation management, processing and mechanization.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Mozambique is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: Cuamba Agri-Hub infrastructure procurement advances under Mozambique SAPZ
articles.summary: The African Development Bank published an October 2026 procurement notice for the Cuamba Agri-Hub signature gate, road accessibility and supporting office in Niassa Province under the Pemba-Lichinga Integrated Development Corridor Special Agri-Industrial Processing Zone.

articles.title: IFAD-backed PROCAVA expands climate-resilient agrifood value-chain focus in Mozambique
articles.summary: IFAD's current project page describes PROCAVA across 75 districts and all 10 provinces, targeting irrigated horticulture, red meat, poultry, cassava and legumes to improve resilient rural incomes.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Mozambique is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: Farmer Field Schools build climate resilience across Greater Maputo
articles.summary: FAO's Greater Maputo ecosystem-based adaptation project established 14 Farmer Field Schools serving 377 farmers, 85 percent of them women, with practical training in vegetable production, agroecology, soil and water management and climate-resilient farming.

fr.title: Les champs-écoles paysans renforcent la résilience climatique dans le Grand Maputo
fr.summary: Le projet d’adaptation de la FAO dans le Grand Maputo a mis en place 14 champs-écoles paysans pour 377 agriculteurs, dont 85 % de femmes, avec une formation pratique en maraîchage, agroécologie et agriculture résiliente au climat.

ar.title: مدارس المزارعين الحقلية تعزز القدرة على مواجهة تغير المناخ في منطقة مابوتو الكبرى
ar.summary: أنشأ مشروع التكيف التابع لمنظمة الأغذية والزراعة في منطقة مابوتو الكبرى 14 مدرسة حقلية لخدمة 377 مزارعاً، 85 بالمئة منهم نساء، مع تدريب عملي على زراعة الخضروات والزراعة الإيكولوجية والممارسات المقاومة للمناخ.

pt.title: Escolas de Campo para Agricultores reforçam a resiliência climática na Grande Maputo
pt.summary: O projeto de adaptação da FAO na Grande Maputo criou 14 Escolas de Campo para Agricultores, envolvendo 377 agricultores, 85% dos quais mulheres, com formação prática em horticultura, agroecologia e agricultura resiliente ao clima.

sw.title: Shule za Wakulima Mashambani zaimarisha ustahimilivu wa tabianchi katika eneo kubwa la Maputo
sw.summary: Mradi wa FAO wa kukabiliana na mabadiliko ya tabianchi katika eneo kubwa la Maputo umeanzisha shule 14 za wakulima zinazohudumia wakulima 377, asilimia 85 wakiwa wanawake, kwa mafunzo ya bustani za mboga, agroikolojia na kilimo kinachostahimili tabianchi.

articles.title: Agricultural support gives new opportunities to families in Mozambique's Balama district
articles.summary: FAO describes support for vulnerable households in Cabo Delgado through agricultural inputs and technical assistance for horticulture and staple crops, helping smallholder families address shortages of seeds, tools and production knowledge.

fr.title: L’aide agricole ouvre de nouvelles perspectives aux familles du district de Balama au Mozambique
fr.summary: La FAO décrit un soutien aux ménages vulnérables de Cabo Delgado sous forme d’intrants agricoles et d’assistance technique pour les cultures maraîchères et vivrières, afin de surmonter le manque de semences, d’outils et de connaissances.

ar.title: الدعم الزراعي يفتح آفاقاً جديدة للأسر في منطقة بالاما بموزمبيق
ar.summary: توضح منظمة الأغذية والزراعة دعم الأسر الضعيفة في كابو ديلغادو بالمدخلات الزراعية والمساعدة الفنية لإنتاج الخضروات والمحاصيل الغذائية، لمواجهة نقص البذور والأدوات والمعرفة الزراعية.

pt.title: Apoio agrícola abre novas oportunidades para famílias no distrito de Balama, em Moçambique
pt.summary: A FAO descreve o apoio a famílias vulneráveis de Cabo Delgado com insumos agrícolas e assistência técnica para horticultura e culturas alimentares, ajudando a superar a falta de sementes, ferramentas e conhecimentos de produção.

sw.title: Msaada wa kilimo wafungua fursa mpya kwa familia katika wilaya ya Balama, Msumbiji
sw.summary: FAO inaeleza msaada kwa kaya zilizo hatarini Cabo Delgado kupitia pembejeo za kilimo na ushauri wa kiufundi kwa mboga na mazao ya chakula, ili kukabiliana na uhaba wa mbegu, zana na maarifa ya uzalishaji.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Namibia is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: FAO strengthens early action around Southern Africa climate outlook
articles.summary: FAO highlighted the 2026 Southern Africa climate outlook and the need for early agricultural preparedness as drier conditions were forecast for the coming season.

articles.title: Japan-funded resilience project delivers first agricultural inputs to Namibia's Hardap farming communities
articles.summary: FAO, Namibia's agriculture ministry and Japan began delivering seeds, tools, solar irrigation, shade-net and hydroponic systems, plus climate-smart farming training, under a project targeting drought-affected households and extension services.

fr.title: Un projet de résilience financé par le Japon fournit ses premiers intrants agricoles aux communautés de Hardap en Namibie
fr.summary: La FAO, le ministère namibien de l’Agriculture et le Japon ont commencé à distribuer semences, outils, irrigation solaire, structures d’ombrage et systèmes hydroponiques, accompagnés d’une formation à l’agriculture adaptée au climat pour les ménages touchés par la sécheresse.

ar.title: مشروع للصمود بتمويل ياباني يسلّم أول مدخلات زراعية لمجتمعات هارداب في ناميبيا
ar.summary: بدأت منظمة الأغذية والزراعة ووزارة الزراعة الناميبية واليابان توزيع البذور والأدوات وأنظمة الري بالطاقة الشمسية ومظلات الزراعة وأنظمة الزراعة المائية، إلى جانب التدريب على الزراعة المتكيفة مع المناخ للأسر المتضررة من الجفاف.

pt.title: Projeto de resiliência financiado pelo Japão entrega os primeiros insumos agrícolas às comunidades de Hardap, na Namíbia
pt.summary: A FAO, o Ministério da Agricultura da Namíbia e o Japão começaram a distribuir sementes, ferramentas, irrigação solar, estruturas de sombra e sistemas hidropónicos, além de formação em agricultura adaptada ao clima para famílias afetadas pela seca.

sw.title: Mradi wa ustahimilivu unaofadhiliwa na Japani wakabidhi pembejeo za kwanza kwa jamii za wakulima Hardap nchini Namibia
sw.summary: FAO, Wizara ya Kilimo ya Namibia na Japani zimeanza kusambaza mbegu, zana, umwagiliaji wa nishati ya jua, miundo ya kivuli na mifumo ya hydroponiki, pamoja na mafunzo ya kilimo kinachokabiliana na tabianchi kwa kaya zilizoathiriwa na ukame.

articles.title: A Namibian poultry farmer rebuilds her livelihood in drought-hit Erongo
articles.summary: FAO's farmer profile describes how poultry became a more manageable source of food and income for a rural woman farmer in drought-affected Erongo, highlighting small-scale livestock production and livelihood resilience.

fr.title: Une avicultrice namibienne reconstruit ses moyens de subsistance dans la région d’Erongo touchée par la sécheresse
fr.summary: Le portrait d’une agricultrice publié par la FAO montre comment l’élevage de volailles est devenu une source plus gérable de nourriture et de revenus pour une femme vivant dans la région d’Erongo frappée par la sécheresse.

ar.title: مزارعة دواجن ناميبية تعيد بناء سبل عيشها في إيرونغو المتضررة من الجفاف
ar.summary: يعرض تقرير لمنظمة الأغذية والزراعة كيف أصبحت تربية الدواجن مصدراً أسهل للإدارة للغذاء والدخل بالنسبة إلى مزارعة تعيش في منطقة إيرونغو المتضررة من الجفاف.

pt.title: Criadora de aves namibiana reconstrói os seus meios de subsistência na região de Erongo, afetada pela seca
pt.summary: O perfil de uma agricultora publicado pela FAO mostra como a criação de aves se tornou uma fonte mais fácil de gerir de alimentos e rendimento para uma mulher numa região de Erongo atingida pela seca.

sw.title: Mfugaji wa kuku nchini Namibia ajenga upya maisha yake katika Erongo iliyoathiriwa na ukame
sw.summary: Wasifu wa mkulima uliochapishwa na FAO unaonyesha jinsi ufugaji wa kuku ulivyokuwa chanzo rahisi zaidi cha chakula na mapato kwa mwanamke anayeishi katika eneo la Erongo lililoathiriwa na ukame.

articles.title: World Bank publishes implementation aide-memoire for Niger irrigated-crops and livestock intensification project
articles.summary: The World Bank's October 2025 aide-memoire documents an implementation support mission for Niger's PACIPA project, covering irrigated-crop development and intensification of livestock production.

articles.title: FAO, Niger and development partners reaffirm cooperation for inclusive and sustainable agriculture
articles.summary: Following a high-level mission to Niamey, FAO and Niger's government reviewed cooperation on agriculture, rural transformation and the humanitarian-development-peace nexus, reaffirming support for inclusive and sustainable agrifood systems.

fr.title: La FAO, le Niger et les partenaires au développement réaffirment leur coopération pour une agriculture inclusive et durable
fr.summary: À l’issue d’une mission de haut niveau à Niamey, la FAO et le gouvernement nigérien ont examiné leur coopération dans l’agriculture, la transformation rurale et le lien entre action humanitaire, développement et paix.

ar.title: منظمة الأغذية والزراعة والنيجر وشركاء التنمية يجددون التعاون من أجل زراعة شاملة ومستدامة
ar.summary: عقب بعثة رفيعة المستوى إلى نيامي، بحثت منظمة الأغذية والزراعة والحكومة النيجرية التعاون في الزراعة والتحول الريفي والترابط بين العمل الإنساني والتنمية والسلام.

pt.title: FAO, Níger e parceiros de desenvolvimento reafirmam cooperação para uma agricultura inclusiva e sustentável
pt.summary: Após uma missão de alto nível a Niamey, a FAO e o governo do Níger analisaram a cooperação em agricultura, transformação rural e na ligação entre ação humanitária, desenvolvimento e paz.

sw.title: FAO, Niger na washirika wa maendeleo wathibitisha tena ushirikiano kwa kilimo jumuishi na endelevu
sw.summary: Baada ya ujumbe wa ngazi ya juu mjini Niamey, FAO na serikali ya Niger zilipitia ushirikiano katika kilimo, mageuzi ya vijijini na uhusiano kati ya hatua za kibinadamu, maendeleo na amani.

articles.title: IITA strengthens seed systems in São Tomé and Príncipe
articles.summary: IITA is supporting seed-system development for cassava, maize, sweet potato and yam to strengthen food security and rural livelihoods.

articles.title: IFAD project page: Transition towards sustainable and nutritious food systems in São Tomé and Príncipe
articles.summary: IFAD's official project page records the transition programme for more sustainable and nutritious food systems in São Tomé and Príncipe, with project design and financing information.

articles.title: FAO and São Tomé and Príncipe prepare the country's General Agricultural Census
articles.summary: FAO and the government signed a technical-assistance agreement to prepare the General Agricultural Census, strengthening agricultural statistics for planning, monitoring and rural-development policy.
articles.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

articles.title: African countries strengthen capacities on agricultural heritage systems
articles.summary: FAO reported that a Johannesburg workshop brought 16 African countries together to strengthen agricultural heritage system proposals, action plans and partnerships.

fr.title: Les pays africains renforcent leurs capacités sur les systèmes de patrimoine agricole
fr.summary: La FAO a indiqué qu'un atelier organisé à Johannesburg a réuni 16 pays africains pour renforcer les propositions, plans d'action et partenariats relatifs aux systèmes de patrimoine agricole.

ar.title: الدول الأفريقية تعزز قدراتها بشأن نظم التراث الزراعي
ar.summary: أفادت الفاو بأن ورشة عمل في جوهانسبرغ جمعت 16 دولة أفريقية لتعزيز المقترحات وخطط العمل والشراكات الخاصة بنظم التراث الزراعي.

pt.title: Países africanos reforçam capacidades sobre sistemas de património agrícola
pt.summary: A FAO informou que um workshop realizado em Joanesburgo reuniu 16 países africanos para reforçar propostas, planos de ação e parcerias sobre sistemas de património agrícola.

sw.title: Nchi za Afrika zinaimarisha uwezo kuhusu mifumo ya urithi wa kilimo
sw.summary: FAO iliripoti kuwa warsha iliyofanyika Johannesburg ilileta pamoja nchi 16 za Afrika ili kuimarisha mapendekezo, mipango ya utekelezaji na ushirikiano kuhusu mifumo ya urithi wa kilimo.

articles.title: World Bank adds $140 million for Senegal's agricultural production areas
articles.summary: Additional financing is expanding resilient rural connectivity, processing platforms, storage, market access and community infrastructure in major agricultural corridors.

articles.title: FAO highlights stronger implementation of Africa's agrifood commitments
articles.summary: FAO's regional conference work in Africa is emphasizing implementation, investment, innovation and measurable results for agrifood transformation.

articles.title: Senegal launches AgriConnect Compact for grains, horticulture and livestock
articles.summary: Senegal launched a country-led framework combining infrastructure and services, policy reform and private investment across grains, horticulture and livestock.

articles.title: World Bank Group soil-health programme expands agricultural-support reform
articles.summary: Senegal is one of six African countries participating in a programme focused on better fertilizer-support design, soil health and agricultural productivity.

articles.title: African countries strengthen tools for better agrifood public spending
articles.summary: FAO reported new work helping African countries use evidence and tools to improve agrifood public spending and investment planning.

articles.title: FAO strengthens West Africa climate and environment support mechanism
articles.summary: FAO's West Africa regional office strengthened its Climate and Environment mechanism to help countries translate climate and environmental priorities into resilient agrifood-system action.

articles.title: FAO Senegal highlights women farmers and rural entrepreneurs
articles.summary: Women farmers, livestock keepers, processors, oyster harvesters, beekeepers and rural entrepreneurs were highlighted during Senegal activities recognising their role in food security and local development.

articles.title: Senegal joins regional scale-up of climate-smart agricultural innovation
articles.summary: The AICCRA–FSRP4 initiative includes Senegal among six African countries where climate-smart agricultural solutions and climate information services are being expanded.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Seychelles green recovery and climate-resilience programme appraisal report
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's October 2026 appraisal report describes a programme supporting green recovery and climate resilience, including the agriculture and agro-industry sector among its areas of relevance.

articles.title: FAO and Seychelles reaffirm cooperation on fisheries, agriculture and the blue economy
articles.summary: FAO Director-General QU Dongyu met Seychelles' minister responsible for fisheries, agriculture and the blue economy to discuss continued cooperation and support for the country's agrifood systems and fisheries sector.
articles.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

fr.title: La FAO et les Seychelles réaffirment leur coopération dans la pêche, l’agriculture et l’économie bleue
fr.summary: Le Directeur général de la FAO a rencontré le ministre des Seychelles chargé de la pêche, de l’agriculture et de l’économie bleue afin d’évoquer la poursuite de la coopération et du soutien aux systèmes agroalimentaires et au secteur halieutique du pays.

ar.title: منظمة الأغذية والزراعة وسيشل تؤكدان التعاون في مصايد الأسماك والزراعة والاقتصاد الأزرق
ar.summary: التقى المدير العام للمنظمة وزير سيشل المسؤول عن مصايد الأسماك والزراعة والاقتصاد الأزرق لبحث مواصلة التعاون ودعم النظم الزراعية والغذائية وقطاع مصايد الأسماك في البلاد.

pt.title: FAO e Seychelles reafirmam cooperação na pesca, agricultura e economia azul
pt.summary: O diretor-geral da FAO reuniu-se com o ministro das Seychelles responsável pelas pescas, agricultura e economia azul para discutir a continuidade da cooperação e do apoio aos sistemas agroalimentares e ao setor das pescas do país.

sw.title: FAO na Shelisheli zathibitisha ushirikiano katika uvuvi, kilimo na uchumi wa buluu
sw.summary: Mkurugenzi Mkuu wa FAO alikutana na waziri wa Shelisheli anayehusika na uvuvi, kilimo na uchumi wa buluu kujadili kuendeleza ushirikiano na msaada kwa mifumo ya kilimo na chakula pamoja na sekta ya uvuvi.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Sierra Leone 2026 highlights rice and value-chain investment
articles.summary: FAO's Sierra Leone 2026 profile presents USD 760 million of investment opportunities, with rice, mechanization, processing, aggregation and finance among the priorities.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Sierra Leone rice agro-industrial zone Phase I appraisal report
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's appraisal report describes Phase I of Sierra Leone's Rice Special Agro-Industrial Processing Zone project, aligned with the Feed Salone strategy and national rice development goals.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Sierra Leone is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: FAO and Somalia warn of hunger crisis as projected floods and funding shortfalls threaten communities
articles.summary: FAO and Somalia's government warned that projected October–December flooding and funding shortfalls could worsen hunger and acute malnutrition, disrupt farming and livestock livelihoods, and displace rural communities.

fr.title: Les risques d'inondation et les déficits de financement menacent les communautés vulnérables
fr.summary: La FAO a signalé que les inondations prévues et les déficits de financement continuent de menacer la sécurité alimentaire et les moyens de subsistance en Somalie.

ar.title: مخاطر الفيضانات ونقص التمويل يهددان المجتمعات الهشة
ar.summary: أفادت الفاو بأن الفيضانات المتوقعة ونقص التمويل لا يزالان يشكلان تهديداً للأمن الغذائي وسبل العيش في الصومال.

pt.title: Riscos de cheias e défices de financiamento ameaçam comunidades vulneráveis
pt.summary: A FAO informou que as cheias previstas e os défices de financiamento continuam a ameaçar a segurança alimentar e os meios de subsistência na Somália.

sw.title: Hatari za mafuriko na upungufu wa fedha zinatishia jamii zilizo hatarini
sw.summary: FAO iliripoti kuwa mafuriko yanayotarajiwa na upungufu wa fedha vinaendelea kutishia usalama wa chakula na maisha ya watu nchini Somalia.

articles.title: AfDB publishes completion report for Horn of Africa rural-livelihoods climate adaptation project
articles.summary: The African Development Bank published a completion report for IGAD's Rural Livelihoods' Adaptation to Climate Change II project, including Somalia, covering pastoral resilience, water management, livestock services and livelihood diversification.

articles.title: Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum advances regional agrifood investment pipeline
articles.summary: FAO's Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum brought governments, investors and partners together around investment-ready opportunities in livestock, coffee, rice, irrigation, fisheries and aquaculture.
articles.source: FAO Subregional Office for Eastern Africa

articles.title: AfDB advances gender and social inclusion under Somalia's BREFONS project
articles.summary: Current project support focuses on mainstreaming gender and social inclusion and strengthening participation of women, youth and vulnerable groups in resilience activities.

articles.title: FAO warns of elevated Deyr flooding risk in Somalia and urges early action
articles.summary: FAO's Somalia Water and Land Information Management programme highlighted a strong forecast signal for above-normal rainfall and potential severe flooding during the October–December 2026 Deyr season.

articles.title: South Sudan launches US$41.8 million sustainable agriculture and rural resilience project
articles.summary: IFAD and the Government of South Sudan launched SADEP to support more than 110,000 people through climate-resilient sorghum and fisheries value chains, market access, finance, extension and rural infrastructure.

articles.title: Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum advances regional agrifood investment pipeline
articles.summary: FAO's Eastern Africa Hand-in-Hand forum brought governments, investors and partners together around investment-ready opportunities in livestock, coffee, rice, irrigation, fisheries and aquaculture.
articles.source: FAO Subregional Office for Eastern Africa

articles.title: South Sudan Agriculture Conference calls for scaled investment to reduce food import dependence
articles.summary: FAO reported that South Sudan's May 2026 Agriculture Conference brought government, development partners and private-sector actors together to identify investment opportunities across crops, livestock, fisheries and agricultural technology, aiming to strengthen domestic production and reduce reliance on food imports.
articles.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

fr.title: La conférence agricole du Soudan du Sud appelle à accroître les investissements pour réduire la dépendance aux importations alimentaires
fr.summary: La FAO indique que la conférence agricole de mai 2026 a réuni le gouvernement, les partenaires de développement et le secteur privé afin d’identifier des investissements dans les cultures, l’élevage, la pêche et les technologies agricoles pour renforcer la production nationale.

ar.title: مؤتمر الزراعة في جنوب السودان يدعو إلى زيادة الاستثمار للحد من الاعتماد على واردات الغذاء
ar.summary: أفادت منظمة الأغذية والزراعة بأن مؤتمر الزراعة في مايو 2026 جمع الحكومة وشركاء التنمية والقطاع الخاص لتحديد فرص الاستثمار في المحاصيل والثروة الحيوانية ومصايد الأسماك والتكنولوجيا الزراعية لتعزيز الإنتاج المحلي.

pt.title: Conferência Agrícola do Sudão do Sul pede mais investimento para reduzir a dependência das importações de alimentos
pt.summary: A FAO informou que a conferência agrícola de maio de 2026 reuniu o governo, parceiros de desenvolvimento e o setor privado para identificar investimentos em culturas, pecuária, pesca e tecnologia agrícola, reforçando a produção nacional.

sw.title: Mkutano wa Kilimo wa Sudan Kusini wataka uwekezaji zaidi kupunguza utegemezi wa uagizaji wa chakula
sw.summary: FAO iliripoti kuwa mkutano wa kilimo wa Mei 2026 uliwakutanisha serikali, washirika wa maendeleo na sekta binafsi kutambua uwekezaji katika mazao, mifugo, uvuvi na teknolojia ya kilimo ili kuimarisha uzalishaji wa ndani.

articles.title: FAO launches nationwide livestock vaccination campaign in Sudan
articles.summary: FAO launched its 2026–2027 vaccination campaign to protect 9.8 million animals and support 1.2 million livestock-owning households amid conflict and food-security pressures.

fr.title: La FAO lance une campagne nationale de vaccination du bétail
fr.summary: La FAO a annoncé une campagne nationale de vaccination du bétail au Soudan visant à protéger la sécurité alimentaire et les moyens de subsistance ruraux dans le contexte du conflit.

ar.title: الفاو تطلق حملة وطنية لتطعيم الثروة الحيوانية
ar.summary: أعلنت الفاو عن حملة وطنية لتطعيم الثروة الحيوانية في السودان تهدف إلى حماية الأمن الغذائي وسبل العيش الريفية وسط الصراع.

pt.title: FAO lança campanha nacional de vacinação do gado
pt.summary: A FAO informou sobre uma campanha nacional de vacinação do gado no Sudão destinada a proteger a segurança alimentar e os meios de subsistência rurais em meio ao conflito.

sw.title: FAO yazindua kampeni ya kitaifa ya chanjo kwa mifugo
sw.summary: FAO imeripoti kampeni ya kitaifa ya chanjo kwa mifugo nchini Sudan inayolenga kulinda usalama wa chakula na maisha ya vijijini wakati wa mzozo.

articles.title: AfDB and WFP launch $87 million BOOST agriculture resilience project in Sudan
articles.summary: BOOST is designed to help farming communities restore production, reduce post-harvest losses, improve incomes and strengthen links to local markets.

articles.title: AfDB and partners launch BOOST to strengthen Sudan's agricultural recovery
articles.summary: BOOST targets 232,000 smallholder farmers in Blue Nile and Sennar, combining climate-resilient seeds, technology, storage, processing and finance for youth and women.

articles.title: IITA partners advance Sudan Digital Agriculture and Food Safety Academy
articles.summary: The pilot is building digital learning resources on food safety, climate-smart agriculture, agronomy, plant health and postharvest management for Sudanese farmers and agribusinesses.

articles.title: AfDB updates Togo agro-food transformation project implementation record
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's project page lists 2026 implementation progress and procurement notices for PTA-Togo, an agro-food transformation programme supporting value chains, investment, storage and processing infrastructure.

articles.title: World Bank approves US$300 million programme to modernize Togo's agribusiness and animal-nutrition sector
articles.summary: The World Bank approved a results-based programme to scale Togo's Agricultural Modernization Program, improve productivity and strengthen agribusiness and animal nutrition value chains.

articles.title: AfDB lists new agro-industrial park procurement under Togo's PTA-Togo programme
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's project record lists a June 2026 contract award related to construction of the Broukou agro-industrial park under Togo's agro-food transformation programme.

articles.title: World Bank approves Tunisia irrigation water security and agricultural resilience project
articles.summary: The World Bank approved a US$124 million project to modernize irrigation services, rehabilitate key infrastructure, strengthen irrigation operators and help farmers adopt climate-smart technologies and access higher-value markets.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Tunisia cereal-sector support project implementation update
articles.summary: The African Development Bank's project page lists a June 2026 implementation progress report for Tunisia's PADIDFIC programme, which supports an inclusive and sustainable cereal value chain and food self-sufficiency.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Tunisia cereal-sector project implementation progress report
articles.summary: The African Development Bank published an implementation progress and results report for Tunisia's PADIDFIC cereal-sector programme, which aims to improve food security and self-sufficiency through support across the cereal value chain.

articles.title: Zimbabwe presents investment opportunities at FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum
articles.summary: FAO reported Zimbabwe's participation in the 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum to present agrifood investment opportunities.

fr.title: Le Zimbabwe présente des opportunités d'investissement au Forum d'investissement Hand-in-Hand de la FAO
fr.summary: La FAO a indiqué que le Zimbabwe a participé au Forum d'investissement Hand-in-Hand 2026 pour présenter des opportunités d'investissement dans les systèmes agroalimentaires.

ar.title: زيمبابوي تعرض فرصاً استثمارية في منتدى الفاو للاستثمار ضمن مبادرة هاند-إن-هاند
ar.summary: أفادت الفاو بأن زيمبابوي شاركت في منتدى الاستثمار هاند-إن-هاند لعام 2026 لعرض فرص الاستثمار في النظم الزراعية والغذائية.

pt.title: Zimbabué apresenta oportunidades de investimento no Fórum de Investimento Hand-in-Hand da FAO
pt.summary: A FAO informou que o Zimbabué participou no Fórum de Investimento Hand-in-Hand 2026 para apresentar oportunidades de investimento nos sistemas agroalimentares.

sw.title: Zimbabwe yaonyesha fursa za uwekezaji katika Jukwaa la Uwekezaji la FAO la Hand-in-Hand
sw.summary: FAO iliripoti kuwa Zimbabwe ilishiriki katika Jukwaa la Uwekezaji la Hand-in-Hand 2026 ili kuwasilisha fursa za uwekezaji katika mifumo ya kilimo na chakula.

articles.title: AfDB approves $25 million climate-resilience grant for Zimbabwe
articles.summary: The ACRES project targets climate-exposed rural communities and aims to strengthen smallholder agriculture, grazing areas, water resources and private-sector investment.

articles.title: AfDB publishes Zimbabwe ACRES agricultural climate-resilience project notice
articles.summary: The African Development Fund's project notice describes Zimbabwe's Agricultural Climate Resilient and Vulnerability Reduction Project, designed to strengthen rural resilience, grazing areas, water resources and agricultural input supply chains.

articles.title: Zambezi Basin countries advance $130 million climate-resilience programme
articles.summary: Zimbabwe is participating in the AfDB-supported Zambezi Basin programme, which is advancing climate-smart agriculture, water management, resilient livelihoods and food security across the eight basin countries.

articles.title: Country joins 2026 FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum for agrifood investment
articles.summary: Zimbabwe is among 20 African countries presenting government-led agrifood investment plans at the FAO 2026 Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum in Rome from 13–16 October 2026.

articles.title: FAO Hand-in-Hand Zimbabwe 2026 — agrifood investment opportunities
articles.summary: Zimbabwe's 2026 Hand-in-Hand investment plan includes mechanization, irrigation and agrifood value-chain investment opportunities.

articles.title: Zimbabwe takes USD 1.65 billion agrifood portfolio to FAO Hand-in-Hand Investment Forum
articles.summary: Zimbabwe's 2026 Hand-in-Hand portfolio includes maize, soyabean, blueberries, dairy and the Dam as an Economic driver, with combined investment needs of USD 1.65 billion.

articles.title: FAO calls for stronger implementation of CAADP commitments
articles.summary: FAO urged African countries to move from commitments to implementation, investment and measurable results as the continent pursues agrifood-system transformation.

articles.title: Zimbabwe advances five-year seed roadmap and investment plan
articles.summary: A May 2026 Seed Business Summit and Roadmap Workshop brought government, CGIAR and sector partners together around a five-year roadmap covering variety development, seed production, certification, marketing and farmer access.

articles.title: Zimbabwe establishes a national platform for smarter post-harvest management
articles.summary: FAO and Zimbabwe's government established a national technical working group to coordinate storage, handling, cold-chain, processing and other measures to reduce post-harvest losses and improve farmer incomes across staple and livestock value chains.
articles.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

fr.title: Le Zimbabwe crée une plateforme nationale pour améliorer la gestion après récolte
fr.summary: La FAO et le gouvernement zimbabwéen ont créé un groupe technique national pour coordonner le stockage, la manutention, la chaîne du froid et la transformation, afin de réduire les pertes après récolte et d’améliorer les revenus des agriculteurs.

ar.title: زيمبابوي تنشئ منصة وطنية لتحسين إدارة ما بعد الحصاد
ar.summary: أنشأت منظمة الأغذية والزراعة والحكومة الزيمبابوية فريق عمل تقنياً وطنياً لتنسيق التخزين والمناولة والتبريد والتصنيع، بهدف الحد من فاقد ما بعد الحصاد وتحسين دخل المزارعين.

pt.title: Zimbábue cria plataforma nacional para melhorar a gestão pós-colheita
pt.summary: A FAO e o governo do Zimbábue criaram um grupo técnico nacional para coordenar armazenamento, manuseamento, cadeia de frio e processamento, reduzindo perdas pós-colheita e melhorando os rendimentos dos agricultores.

sw.title: Zimbabwe yaanzisha jukwaa la kitaifa kuboresha usimamizi baada ya mavuno
sw.summary: FAO na serikali ya Zimbabwe zimeanzisha kikundi cha kitaifa cha kiufundi kuratibu uhifadhi, ushughulikiaji, minyororo ya baridi na uchakataji ili kupunguza upotevu baada ya mavuno na kuongeza mapato ya wakulima.

articles.title: FAO and China support Zimbabwean farmers to restore soil fertility and crop yields
articles.summary: A soil-management initiative in Zvimba District is helping farmers and extension officers use soil testing and locally appropriate land-management practices to address declining fertility and improve the resilience of crop production.
articles.source: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)

fr.title: La FAO et la Chine aident les agriculteurs zimbabwéens à restaurer la fertilité des sols et les rendements
fr.summary: Une initiative de gestion des sols dans le district de Zvimba aide les agriculteurs et les agents de vulgarisation à utiliser les analyses de sol et des pratiques adaptées pour lutter contre la baisse de fertilité et renforcer la résilience des cultures.

ar.title: منظمة الأغذية والزراعة والصين تدعمان مزارعي زيمبابوي لاستعادة خصوبة التربة والمحاصيل
ar.summary: تساعد مبادرة لإدارة التربة في مقاطعة زيمبا المزارعين وموظفي الإرشاد على استخدام فحوص التربة وممارسات مناسبة محلياً لمعالجة تراجع الخصوبة وتعزيز قدرة المحاصيل على الصمود.

pt.title: FAO e China apoiam agricultores do Zimbábue na recuperação da fertilidade do solo e da produtividade
pt.summary: Uma iniciativa de gestão do solo no distrito de Zvimba ajuda agricultores e extensionistas a usar análises de solo e práticas adequadas ao contexto local para enfrentar a perda de fertilidade e aumentar a resiliência das culturas.

sw.title: FAO na China zawaunga mkono wakulima wa Zimbabwe kurejesha rutuba ya udongo na mavuno
sw.summary: Mpango wa usimamizi wa udongo katika wilaya ya Zvimba unawasaidia wakulima na maafisa ugani kutumia vipimo vya udongo na mbinu zinazofaa eneo husika kukabiliana na kupungua kwa rutuba na kuimarisha ustahimilivu wa mazao.

articles.title: Zimbabwe strengthens agricultural coordination and anticipatory action ahead of the 2026/27 season
articles.summary: Zimbabwe's agriculture development partners coordinated government, investors and technical agencies around preparedness for the 2026/27 season, including early action and resilience planning in response to increasing climate variability.

fr.title: Le Zimbabwe renforce la coordination agricole et l’anticipation avant la campagne 2026-2027
fr.summary: Les partenaires du développement agricole du Zimbabwe ont coordonné les pouvoirs publics, les investisseurs et les organismes techniques pour préparer la campagne 2026-2027 et renforcer la résilience face à une variabilité climatique croissante.

ar.title: زيمبابوي تعزز التنسيق الزراعي والعمل الاستباقي استعداداً لموسم 2026-2027
ar.summary: نسّق شركاء التنمية الزراعية في زيمبابوي جهود الحكومة والمستثمرين والجهات الفنية للاستعداد لموسم 2026-2027 وتعزيز القدرة على الصمود أمام تزايد تقلبات المناخ.

pt.title: Zimbábue reforça a coordenação agrícola e a ação antecipada para a época de 2026/27
pt.summary: Os parceiros de desenvolvimento agrícola do Zimbábue coordenaram o governo, investidores e agências técnicas para preparar a época de 2026/27 e reforçar a resiliência perante a crescente variabilidade climática.

sw.title: Zimbabwe yaimarisha uratibu wa kilimo na hatua za mapema kabla ya msimu wa 2026/27
sw.summary: Washirika wa maendeleo ya kilimo nchini Zimbabwe waliratibu serikali, wawekezaji na mashirika ya kiufundi kujiandaa kwa msimu wa 2026/27 na kuimarisha ustahimilivu dhidi ya mabadiliko makubwa ya hali ya hewa.
